owners.label: Knowing
owners.description: Gain 5% Electro DMG Bonus after casting Resonance Skill for 8s, stackable for up to 4 times.

owners.label: Focus
owners.description: When in Intuition triggered by Resonance Liberation, Xiangli Yao's resistance to interruption is enhanced.

owners.label: Chain Rule
owners.description: Xiangli Yao will call down a laser beam upon the first target the incoming Resonator's Basic Attack hits, dealing Electro DMG equal to 237.63% of Xiangli Yao's ATK to an area. This effect lasts for 8s and can be triggered once every 2s, up to 3 times.

owners.label: Prodigy of Protégés
owners.description: Resonance Skill Law of Reigns additionally launches 6 Convolution Matrices at enemies, each dealing Resonance Liberation DMG equal to 8% of the skill's DMG Multiplier.

owners.label: Traces of Predecessors
owners.description: Casting Resonance Skill or Resonance Liberation Cogitation Model increases Crit. DMG by 30% for 8s.

owners.label: Ruins of Ancient
owners.description:
Casting Resonance Liberation Cogitation Model increases the DMG of the following Resonance Skill moves by 63% for 24s:
Decipher, Deduction, Divergence, and Law of Reigns.
This effect can be triggered up to 5 times.

owners.label: Vessel of Rebirth
owners.description: Casting Resonance Liberation Cogitation Model grants a 25% DMG Bonus to all team members' Resonance Liberation for 30s.

owners.label: End of Stars
owners.description: The DMG Multiplier of Outro Skill Chain Rule is increased by 222%. The DMG Multiplier of Resonance Liberation Cogitation Model is increased by 100%.

owners.label: Solace of the Ordinary
owners.description: The Hypercubes obtained from Resonance Liberation Cogitation Model are enhanced, increasing the DMG Multiplier of Resonance Skill Law of Reigns by 76%.
